nodes.label: Triage the alert
nodes.detail: Confirm the alert is real and find which service it names.

nodes.label: Page the on-call
nodes.detail: For customer-facing impact. The on-call engineer takes over now.

nodes.label: Open a ticket
nodes.detail: For internal-only problems. Handled in working hours.

nodes.label: Mitigate
nodes.detail: Roll back, fail over or shed load until the symptoms stop.

nodes.label: Write the postmortem
nodes.detail: Blameless review: timeline, cause, and the follow-up actions.

beats.title: The alert fires
beats.caption: Checkout error rate passes its threshold at 14:02.

beats.title: Triage confirms the scope
beats.caption: Two regions show errors, so the impact is real.

beats.title: Customers are affected
beats.caption: Payments fail for some users, so the on-call is paged.

beats.title: Mitigation starts
beats.caption: The on-call rolls back the last deploy.

beats.title: The fix is checked
beats.caption: Error rate is back to normal, so the incident can close.

beats.title: The incident is resolved
beats.caption: No symptoms remain, so the review starts.

beats.title: The postmortem is published
beats.caption: The timeline and follow-ups go to the team.
